# FLUX 3 Image vs Klein

**Workflow:** [`flux3/flux3-image-vs-klein.json`](../flux3/flux3-image-vs-klein.json)

| | |
| --- | --- |
| Family | `flux3` |
| Nodes | 12 |
| Links | 9 |
| Paid API calls per run | **2** |

---

The same image and the same instruction through both FLUX 3 models, side by side, so you can see what the cheaper, faster Klein gives up on your kind of edit before committing a batch to either.

**Anything Everywhere** (Use Everywhere) carries the loaded image to both models without a wire each. Its input filter is `^input_image$`, so it only fills each node's first reference socket — never the empty `input_image_2` that appears below it, and never the comparer. Add a third model node and it is fed automatically.

**Fast Groups Bypasser** (rgthree) has one toggle per model group. Switch one off to stop paying for it; a bypassed model passes the source image straight through, so the comparer then shows *source vs the other model*.

**Image Comparer**: `image_a` is FLUX 3 Image, `image_b` is Klein. Two **Display Any** nodes show how each model rewrote the instruction — Klein's upsampler writes a full scene caption.

Klein's `seed` is fixed at 42; FLUX 3 Image has no seed, only the unsent `variation`.

### Needs
[rgthree-comfy](https://github.com/rgthree/rgthree-comfy) and [Use Everywhere](https://github.com/chrisgoringe/cg-use-everywhere). **Manager → Install Missing Custom Nodes** finds both if the graph loads with red nodes. If Use Everywhere is missing, the model nodes get no image and run as **text-to-image** — install it before you queue.

## The prompt lives in one node

The **Shared Prompt** node feeds every FLUX 3 `prompt` in this graph, so there is one
place to edit it. It emits a plain string, **not** a list, so each node it feeds still runs once.
